intro.title: Write a deep clone utility without libraries
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a utility function that creates a deep clone of a JavaScript object. A deep clone is a completely independent copy where nested objects and arrays are also duplicated, not just referenced. You will learn to handle different data types like objects, arrays, and primitives using recursion and type checking. This exercise will strengthen your understanding of object manipulation, recursion, and the structured clone algorithm's limitations in pure JavaScript.
intro.usecase: Deep cloning is essential when working with complex state management in interactive applications like dashboards or form builders. For example, when a user creates a duplicate dashboard panel with customized widgets, you need to copy all nested configuration objects without affecting the original. Similarly, in form builders where users can duplicate sections with nested field validations and conditional logic, deep cloning ensures independent copies. This pattern prevents subtle bugs where modifying a copied object accidentally changes the original data structure.
